Transport Modes

Container Cisterna

A cylindrical, intermodal ISO container used for the safe transport of bulk liquids, gases, and powders under regulated conditions, built to UN portable tank standards.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Container Cisterna?

In this glossary, Container Cisterna refers to: A cylindrical, intermodal ISO container used for the safe transport of bulk liquids, gases, and powders under regulated conditions, built to UN portable tank standards.

How is Container Cisterna used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Le spedizioni di prodotti chimici sfusi devono utilizzare container cisterna conformi alle normative IMDG e ONU."

Why does Container Cisterna matter in logistics?

Container Cisterna matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Modes contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Container Cisterna?

Container Cisterna is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Container Cisterna belong to?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A cylindrical, intermodal ISO container used for the safe transport of bulk liquids, gases, and powders under regulated conditions, built to UN portable tank standards.

Operational example

Bulk chemical shipments must use a tank container that complies with IMDG and UN portable tank regulations for safety and handling.
